COD.rationale: Content (p0/current/n0 red), its origin/status, and the red assignment are all explicitly stated for the same referent/time.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify referents with named attributes (red/blue) and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status is given separately from the identified content attribute for the same referent, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: Entries describe how content is presented/derived (origin metadata) and candidate/current presentation, indicating organization/presentation/access.
